Set as default digital assistant (fallback for IP rotation)
✅ WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS granted (some ROMs still need the assistant)

Run this once from a PC or another device with adb:
adb shell pm grant %1$s android.permission.WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS
It survives reboots and app updates.

Note: on Android 15 / MIUI this alone does NOT toggle the radio — writing the airplane_mode_on setting no longer turns airplane mode on, and the AIRPLANE_MODE broadcast is protected (even adb shell cannot send it). If rotation still fails, use the digital-assistant fallback.
Rotation already running, or relay not started
SOCKS port and control port must differ
Running — waiting for a Tailscale address (is Tailscale connected?)

Setup:
1. In Tailscale, keep THIS app included (not excluded).
2. In Tailscale, EXCLUDE your SOCKS5 proxy app so it can use cellular.
3. Start that proxy on the port below, listening on 127.0.0.1.
Clients then use socks5://<tailscale-ip>:<port>.

Works with any local SOCKS5 proxy — 5G Proxy Pro, Clash, v2rayNG,
shadowsocks-android, or anything else bound to 127.0.0.1.

Remote IP rotation (token required — TOKEN is shown above):

Browser or phone (easiest, works from the address bar):
 http://<tailscale-ip>:<control-port>/rotate?token=$TOKEN

curl (either form):
 curl "http://<tailscale-ip>:<control-port>/rotate?token=$TOKEN"
 curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -X POST http://<tailscale-ip>:<control-port>/rotate

Then poll GET /status (same token).
With the WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS grant, rotation keeps Wi-Fi and Tailscale UP —
only cellular drops, for about 5 seconds, so you can watch state go
running → changed. Without the grant, Wi-Fi drops too and you have to wait
blindly for it to come back.
GET /status also reports OS internet validation (network) and device-wide cellular data usage (data_usage).

Note: rotation only changes the CELLULAR IP. Your proxy must use cellular as its
upstream (e.g. 5G Proxy Pro bound to the mobile network), otherwise the exit IP
will not change even though the phone reconnects.

IP rotation is optional. It needs ONE working way to switch airplane mode:
(a) WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS grant (try first — no assistant replaced):
adb shell pm grant %1$s android.permission.WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS
 → survives reboots and app updates, but on Android 15/MIUI writing the
 airplane_mode_on setting does NOT actually cut the radio
(b) this app set as the default digital assistant (reliable, replaces Google Assistant).
The relay tries (a), verifies the radio really dropped, and falls back to (b).
Everything else works without either.
